app_fee.value: Applicants must submit the required nonrefundable application fee; fee amount is not stated in the catalog admissions section.
app_fee.quote: Applicants must complete the UW graduate application and submit the required nonrefundable application fee.

fee_waiver.value: No application fee waiver policy was found on the official catalog admissions pages.

gre_general.value: The Graduate School does not set a general GRE requirement; standardized tests are required only if specified by the individual academic department.
gre_general.quote: Applicants whose department requires the Graduate Record Examination (GRE) must request official scores be sent directly to the Admissions Office via the Educational Testing Service (ETS), using the University of Wyoming’s institution code: 4855.

toefl_min.value: The University of Wyoming requires a minimum TOEFL score of 76 iBT for international graduate admission.
toefl_min.quote: The minimum acceptable scores are 540 (76 iBT) and 6.5 for TOEFL and IELTS respectively.

ielts_min.value: The University of Wyoming requires a minimum IELTS Academic score of 6.5 for international graduate admission.
ielts_min.quote: The minimum acceptable scores are 540 (76 iBT) and 6.5 for TOEFL and IELTS respectively.

english_waiver.value: Proof of English proficiency is required if native language is not English; a variety of proficiency exams are accepted.
english_waiver.quote: Provide proof of English proficiency if student’s native language is not English. The University of Wyoming accepts a variety of English proficiency exams.
